risk_and_failure_modes: Two completed long lifecycles are too few to estimate repeatable expectancy.
The positive aggregate is winner-dependent and becomes negative after removing the largest winner.
No short onset has been observed, so bidirectional behavior remains untested.
Eight censored paths can materially bias the observed sample.
WebSocket mark gaps, entry-depth gaps, or unresolved shared-portfolio state can still censor future lifecycles.
The REST recorder may be useful for diagnostics but must not be promoted to exact risk-path evidence without timestamp-parity proof.
